title: Baa Juice Cherry Peach Lemonade Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Cherry Peach Lemonade Shortfill combines three distinctive flavours into a lively fruit medley. Juicy Cherry provides a rich base, Peach adds smooth, sweet notes, and Lemonade rounds it off with a sparkling citrus edge for a bright, refreshing finish. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills are mixed with double-concentrated flavouring for a strong, enduring taste, delivering fruit blends that stay punchy throughout the day.
